svg.title: Bubblewrap Sandbox: confine your agent's commands on the host they run on
svg.desc: The model calls Coder, Shell or FileSystem tools such as run_command and edit_file. BubblewrapSandbox wraps another workspace capability, here SSHWorkspace, and its get_workspace hook runs every command and file operation on that host inside a bwrap sandbox. In the sandbox the working directory is writable, the rest of the host's files are read-only, /tmp is private, /run is empty, and a seccomp filter blocks every socket. The sandbox does not stop commands from reading files the host user can read, signalling the host user's processes, or writing files such as git hooks that run unsandboxed later.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: you don't trust, give it its own user on the host, or use a cloud sandbox such as E2B.
